name: Discord
summary: Discord apps get an official bot user that connects over the Gateway (WebSocket) and HTTP API, with slash commands, message components and modals. Bots can be installed to servers or to individual users. Libraries such as discord.js handle the protocol; reading ordinary server messages requires the Message Content privileged intent.
facts: Free to create apps in the Developer Portal
Privileged intent; review required above 10,000 users (since 2026-06-10)
goodFor: Agents that use slash commands and buttons
watchOut: Message Content intent needs review at scale
Privileged intent access must be renewed yearly
Gateway connections need a long-running process
